summary: Purged all 44 legacy placeholder events (fake example.com URLs, invented venues) that were seeded in the repo before this pipeline ever ran for real. Replaced them entirely with verified events: 500 total, every one with a real, checked source URL, spanning sports, concerts, comedy, pop-ups, art, festivals, and food. Highlights: the Lucas Museum's grand opening, Guns N' Roses at BMO Stadium, and the Abbot Kinney Festival. Comedy clubs' nightly volume still dominates the cap, covering through Sept 24.
